info.name: MongoDB Atlas Administration Access Tracking Flex Restore Jobs API
Return All Restore Jobs for One Flex Cluster

params.name: envelope
params.description: Flag that indicates whether Application wraps the response in an `envelope` JSON object. Some API clients cannot access the HTTP response headers or status code. To remediate this, set envelope=true in the query. Endpoints that return a list of results use the results object as an envelope. Application adds the status parameter to the response body.

params.name: groupId
params.description:
Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the [/groups](#tag/Projects/operation/listProjects) endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access.

**NOTE**: Groups and projects are synonymous terms. Your group id is the same as your project id. For existing groups, your group/project id remains the same. The resource and corresponding endpoints use the term groups.

params.name: includeCount
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response returns the total number of items (`totalCount`) in the response.

params.name: itemsPerPage
params.description: Number of items that the response returns per page.

params.name: pageNum
params.description: Number of the page that displays the current set of the total objects that the response returns.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response body should be in the prettyprint format.

params.name: name
params.description: Human-readable label that identifies the flex cluster.

items.docs: Returns all restore jobs for one flex cluster from the specified project. To use this resource, the requesting Service Account or API Key must have the Project Read Only role.
